purpose: Develop a complete physical demonstration in a jointly randomized scene after a necessary initial-direct-contact geometry screen.
base_sampler: Unchanged simulation_lab.random_dinner.draw; all seven items, whole shared tabletop, full yaw and all original alternative orientation families.
candidate_seeds: 2026122001 through 2026122064 inclusive; stop at first passing candidate, without inspecting controller success.
selection: Stable original assess() geometry, then no object with separating-plane certificates against both full arm collision envelopes.
certificate: Compiled serial-hinge geometry, swept shoulder circle plus remaining chain ball, exact object primitive support, contact margins and 10 micrometer numerical reserve. No IK, grasp success, per-object box or learned result enters selection.
interpretation: Passing is necessary initial direct-contact geometry only, not a grasp/route/transfer certificate. Rejected scenes are not globally impossible: prior indirect object-assisted rearrangement is not evaluated.
original_evidence: All original 80 joint scene resets and all development manipulation failures remain unchanged, with their original denominators. This is a new conditional development distribution, not a replacement coverage score.

execution.controller: Privileged shared exact-state demonstration teacher; not a learned policy.
execution.acceptance: Unchanged physical grasp, lift >=25 mm, unsupported hold >=1.8 s, placement/release/parking, <=1 mm external penetration, <=0.8 mm unexpected robot contact, <=4 mm unrelated object displacement, and exact independent/continuous motor replay.

preservation: Retain every proposal recipe, invalid or separated scene, all 600 settling steps with exact independent replay, source snapshots, full passing/failing manipulation traces and observations. No model or physics changes, attachments, live state writes, external forces or overwritten evidence.
storage: Check unused output and console log and 8 GiB expected writes plus 10 GiB reserve before launch; per-candidate and per-export checks continue.
completion: Only all seven final physical settings in the continuously evolving scene count as a complete teacher workflow. This experiment alone cannot fulfill camera-driven coverage, learned control or recovery. No policy fit is authorized by a mere candidate or isolated primitive success.
